description: Zephyr Textiles Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 26 February 1999, converted to a public limited company in October 2004 and is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. It manufactures, dyes and trades woven cloth and towels for home textiles and fashion, running 281 air-jet looms with a capacity of about 80,000 metres of fabric a day, roughly 70% of it for home furnishing.
headOffice: 3rd Floor, IEP Building, 97 B/D-I, Gulberg III, Lahore, Pakistan
sourceNote: Company website (zephyrtextiles.com: home, contact) and the PSX Data Portal company record for ZTL, read 2026-10-17.
